canonical_project: City of Bunbury civic data centre / private cloud platform
owner: City of Bunbury / Stott + Hoare / IBM
notes: GovTechReview reported that the City of Bunbury had built a data centre and migrated more than 35 legacy servers to IBM PureSystems/PureFlex infrastructure, with excess rack, compute and storage capacity for potential hosted council services. A 2008 WA Government release funded power/cooling infrastructure for the Bunbury digital centre's data centre.
